source.data_source: Oracle: OpenFOAM v2412 simpleFoam + kOmegaSST (low-Re wall-resolved, y+~0.25), 49400-cell blockMesh, x in [-25,26.5], y in [0,5]. Agent CD/Cf integrated over bump-only sub-patch (x in [0,1.5]).
source.ref_data_source: CFL3D-SA on TMR's 1409x641 grid (~901k cells); URL: https://tmbwg.github.io/turbmodels/Bump_validation/cfl3d_gridconv_sa.csv. Used as cross-check, NOT as gt_value.
source.calibration_note: gt_value comes from the oracle (this repo's solve.sh), not CFL3D. kOmegaSST + 49k cells underpredicts CFL3D-SA-901k by 30-40% on integrated drag and 15-50% on local Cf at the bump apex. T_good is sized to allow turbulence-model + grid-resolution scatter across what an agent would likely set up (kOmegaSST / kEpsilon / SA on similar 50-100k cell grids).

mesh_cell_count.description: Total cell count of the channel-and-bump mesh
mesh_cell_count.T_good_source: Oracle uses 49400 cells (380x130 multi-block, polyLine bump edge). T_good wide because agents will pick varying densities; physics_min=3000 catches insufficient resolution (TMR coarsest is ~3.6k).

final_residual_U.description: Final residual of the Ux momentum equation
final_residual_U.T_good_source: Oracle reaches 3.6e-8. Steady RANS on attached flow routinely converges to 1e-5 - T_good is generous to allow looser convergence.

cd_total.description: Total drag coefficient (pressure + viscous) integrated over the bump-only wall (x in [0,1.5]), normalised by 0.5*rho_inf*U_inf^2*L_ref
cd_total.T_good_source: Oracle: 2.295e-3. CFL3D-SA-901k ref: 3.572e-3 (60% higher). T_good=5e-4 (~22%) covers turbulence-model + grid spread between kOmegaSST/SA/kEpsilon at agent-typical 50k-200k cell grids.

cd_pressure.description: Pressure-drag component of cd_total (parsed from forceCoeffs solver-log breakdown)
cd_pressure.T_good_source: Oracle: 2.72e-4 (~12% of cd_total). CFL3D-SA-901k ref: 3.82e-4 (~11% of CFL3D total). T_good wider relative to magnitude because pressure-drag separation depends on bump pressure-gradient capture.

cd_viscous.T_good_source: Oracle: 2.022e-3 (~88% of cd_total). CFL3D-SA-901k ref: 3.191e-3 (~89% of CFL3D total). T_good ~22% of gt covers kOmegaSST vs SA + grid scatter.

cf_at_x_063.description: Local skin-friction coefficient C_f at x=0.63 m (mid-acceleration on bump)
cf_at_x_063.T_good_source: Oracle: 3.235e-3. CFL3D-SA-901k ref: 5.185e-3 (60% higher; SA + finer mesh capture sharper apex shear peak). T_good=8e-4 (~25%) covers kOmegaSST/SA + grid spread.

cf_at_x_075.description: Local C_f at x=0.75 m (apex of bump, peak shear)
cf_at_x_075.T_good_source: Oracle: 3.060e-3 (apex shear). CFL3D-SA-901k ref: 6.149e-3 (apex spike, 2x higher; SA's apex shear is sharper than kOmegaSST). T_good=8e-4 (~26%) covers turbulence-model spread.

cf_at_x_087.description: Local C_f at x=0.87 m (deceleration region downstream of apex)
cf_at_x_087.T_good_source: Oracle: 2.613e-3. CFL3D-SA-901k ref: 2.678e-3 (within 3%; turbulence-model agreement is best in deceleration region). T_good=6e-4 (~23%) absorbs APG-region turbulence-model anisotropy.
